title: Conversion to a restricted decision tree
statement: Let $T$ be a coordinate decision tree with values in a type $\alpha$, and let $A$ be a set of available coordinates among the $n$ coordinates. If every query in $T$ uses a coordinate in the currently available set, and both children of each query satisfy the same condition after that coordinate is removed, then $T$ determines a decision tree indexed by $A$: leaves retain their values, and each query has the same two children, indexed by the remaining coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A coordinate decision tree on $n$ coordinates with values in $\alpha$
A finite set $A$ of available coordinates
The tree is well formed relative to $A$
